name: h4_smoke
description: End-to-end smoke test: linear H4 at 1.0 A spacing, sto-3g, AVAS H 1s -> (4e,4o) = the full space, so CASCI == FCI and every solver's exact limit is known. Three sampled solvers (DMET+SQD, DMET+SKQD, LASSQD) x two shot counts x two seeds, plus the deterministic LASSCF reference LASSQD is measured against.
